answer: Make every identity earn admission by completing verifiable useful work reviewed by randomly drawn peers: each task is checked, and a fake that submits junk loses its stake and its slot. One honest agent climbs the summit once, like a single saffron thread in a grove, paying the work a single time. A Sybil farmer must do real, reviewed work for a thousand fakes, and every failed review burns stake — mass fakes become a losing grind, not a shortcut.
